smallerAriDot20261106.promptSummary: Change only the existing Ari and Dot depictions, repainting them at exactly 65% of their current height while preserving pose, outfit, expression, identity, relative scale, art style, lighting, gaze and contact or tether point. Reject ghosts, halos, old fragments, duplicated limbs, malformed hands, wrong chirality, malformed Dot features, text and global redraw.
